about: No new assets and no credits: the Alpha reuses the werewolf enemy (game/assets/characters/werewolf/) with the new werewolf clips from ../../creatures/werewolf/ at a larger scale.

clips.roar: ../../creatures/werewolf/werewolf_anim_roar.glb (intro and phase change; roar peak 0.97 s)

notes: Scale root motion by the same 1.35. Slow the playback to about 0.85x so the larger body reads heavier. Tint the fur darker and give the eyes a stronger glow to tell it apart from common werewolves. Audio: ../../audio/sfx_werewolf_roar.ogg pitched down about 3 semitones.
